csv_scope_of_work: The City of Jacksonville Beach, in coordination with its Community Redevelopment Agency, is soliciting proposals from highly qualified and visionary development teams to engage in a Public-Private Partnership (P3) for the redevelopment of a strategically located, City-owned parcel adjacent to Latham Plaza.
